Lucky vehicle number calculator

Find the digits numerology considers most harmonious for your car or bike registration, from your date of birth.

Lucky Vehicle Number Calculator
Numerology-friendly digits for your vehicle registration, based on your Life Path Number.

How the lucky digits are chosen

The calculator first works out your Life Path Number from your date of birth. Each Life Path Number has a set of digits that numerology treats as friendly to it, and those are the digits shown. When people choose a registration number, they usually look for one whose digits add up to one of these.

To check a number you already have, add all of its digits together and keep adding until you reach a single digit. If that digit is in your list, numerology would call it a good match.

Keep it in proportion

A registration number is a small choice, and numerology treats it as one. It does not make a vehicle safer or a journey luckier. Drive carefully, keep the vehicle maintained, and treat a harmonious number as a pleasant extra.

Frequently asked

Common questions

How do I check my existing vehicle number?

Add every digit on the plate together, then add the digits of the total until you are left with one digit. Compare it with the lucky digits shown for you.

Do the letters on the number plate count?

Most numerologists use only the digits. Some also convert the letters, so if you want that level of detail, ask a numerologist.

Should the number match the owner or the main driver?

Numerologists usually use the date of birth of the person who drives the vehicle most.
